findings.desc: Verification coverage is not fresh at the current REVIEW head: session_brief reports materialHash drift after 5dc6684 with 7 stale verification intent entries. The active Koala role surface scans are clean, but TEST is likely to reject stale evidence unless verification_evidence_refresh_stale and validation are rerun against the current material hash.

Active metadata commit vocabulary still emits Koala: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:3260 and :3389 create `koala:` from-draft/INIT_CHECK metadata commits, packages/main/src/handlers/worktree.ts:318/:546/:858/:923 create or recognize `koala:` story init/discard/auto-add metadata commits, and packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:589 creates `koala:` DONE metadata commits. These are current command paths, not archive docs or signed-artifact salts, so the implementation does not yet satisfy the story requirement that active metadata vocabulary be Lattice.

packages/main/src/handlers/validate-docs-drift.ts:51 still matches `koala <cmd>` even though the gate now claims to extract `lattice <cmd>`, so active Lattice command docs can be missed by docs-drift validation. The same active validation surface still emits Koala provider/schema names such as `koala-channel` at packages/main/src/handlers/validate-channel.ts:41 and user-visible summaries with `metadata-only koala CLI` at packages/main/src/handlers/validate-channel.ts:522-527, plus `koala-concept`/`koala-docs-drift`/`koala-lint`/`koala-serve-validator` provider values. These are not signed-salt or archive exceptions; they are active gates/schemas, so the migration is incomplete.
